faq.q: What is the origin of Adlah?
faq.a: Adlah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of عدلة.
Yes — the underlying form عدلة is Arabic.
Adlah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
